name: video-call
description: 1-on-1 WebRTC video call: React + TypeScript client, Node.js WebSocket signaling server, Electron desktop shell.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n server,client,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.start:desktop: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w desktop && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
